name: chandhana-shoe-mart
description: CHANDHANA SHOE MART - Premium Full-Stack Footwear E-Commerce Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server
scripts.vercel-build: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.render-build: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run prisma:push --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && node server/dist/seed.js
scripts.db:import-turso: npm run build --prefix server && node server/dist/importData.js
scripts.db:import-supabase: npm run build --prefix server && node server/dist/importData.js
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
